built_with: Swift (UIKit, RxSwift) app with a Go wallet library (libwallet, via gomobile) and a Rust zero-knowledge verifier

engine.text: libwallet, Muun's own Go library in the same repository: key handling, 2-of-2 and MuSig2 signing, address creation, fee and payment logic. Muun's server holds the second key and the chain view.

chain_data.text: Muun's own server (Houston API, pub.api.muun.io) supplies history, spendable coins, fees and block height. The person cannot change it. libwallet's Electrum client with a public server list is used only by a scan/sweep RPC the Swift app never calls.

third_party.text: Muun's server: it must co-sign every spend (2-of-2 and MuSig2). Without it, the person needs the Emergency Kit, the Recovery Code and Muun's separate Recovery Tool (github.com/muun/recovery), which is not part of the app.

distribution: App Store (fastlane prd lane uploads com.muun.falcon to App Store Connect and TestFlight; dogfood builds are internal TestFlight)

libraries.text: Swift: Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Messaging), GoogleSignIn and Google Drive API, GRDB.swift, RxSwift, Dip, grpc-swift, Lottie. Go: btcd, lnd (lnwire, zpay32), lightning-onion, go-lnurl, gofpdf, pdfcpu, gorm with SQLite, gRPC.

bitcoin_library_not_counted: btcsuite btcd (btcec, btcutil, txscript, wire, chaincfg, hdkeychain) and lnd, pulled as Go modules via go.mod, are not counted. Copies kept in the repository are counted as libwallet code: btcsuitew/ (bech32m copy, wrappers of btcutil, txscript, chainhash) and musig2v040/ (modified btcec MuSig2 v2.2.2).

prebuilt.text: Rust zero-knowledge proof verifier (plonky2) linked as the static library multi-apple-ios-librs.a, built by libwallet/librs/makelibs.sh and not in the tree; FirebaseAnalytics and GoogleAppMeasurement xcframeworks from dl.google.com

patched: Go 1.24.7 toolchain is patched for cgo struct alignment (falcon/0001-align-to-ptrsize.patch); golang.org/x/mobile is replaced by the muun/mobile fork (libwallet/go.mod:200)
